samples.question: Four panels sit side by side and are read left to right. Each panel shows a horizontal track divided into six slots, slot 0 at the left up to slot 5 at the right, with one red token and one green token sitting on it. The red token and the green token each keep their identity from panel to panel and may move left or right between panels (their positions are drawn in every panel). In a panel, the separation between the two tokens is the absolute difference of their slot indices. Across all four ordered panels, what is the LARGEST separation in slots ever reached between the red token and the green token? Answer with the integer 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, or 5.
